title: village and pillage enhanced
description: this mod adds an upgrade to the pillage and village update and adds pillager camps! in there u can free the allays iron golems and slay the pillagers
body:
this mod adds pillager campa to the game they are a nice adittion and often spawn next to villages there is 4 tents and 1 big tent of the leader there is also 2 cages where iron golems and allays are held Hostage there is also a big fireplace and of course pillagers 

NOTE:  ive seen that the map looks weird and there is no loot (yet) and ill change it soon note that this is a very new mod
anyways have fun testing/playing (:
